fixed.precision: AMP for the vanilla path (unchanged runner behaviour)
fixed.scheduler: five-epoch linear warm-up followed by cosine decay to 1e-6 (unchanged runner behaviour)
fixed.loss: SmoothL1 per task on targets standardized on the L1 training split; vanilla objective = y1_weight*loss1 + y2_weight*loss2
fixed.data: RepB temporal (train/val) + mRMR-selected static features, scalers fitted on the L1 training split, exactly as experiments/exp_r2_mtl_baselines.py::load_fixed_data

search.objective: best validation mean standardized SmoothL1 over the two tasks with equal weights (M.ConflictAwareTrainer.evaluate_loss), i.e. the runner's own checkpoint-selection metric; independent of the trained task weights
search.test_arrays: never loaded in the search and robustness phases (runtime guard on every numpy file read)
search.storage: sqlite study.db inside the output directory; parallel workers allowed only after the smoke confirms memory and runtime

robustness.selection: lowest mean of the per-seed best validation objective over seeds {42 (search trial), 52, 62}; writes tuned_config.json

final.l2_l3_protocol: unchanged runner protocol: 80/20 inner split of the shifted calibration set selects the fine-tuning epoch count, refit on the full calibration set, one evaluation on the shifted test set
